# Battery Evidence and Charging Qualification Supervisor

## Selected system context

### Synopsis, need, purpose, and scope

NEED-01: A configurable logical drone needs a bounded supervisory function that turns
qualitative battery, charger, charging-interface, and read-only lifecycle reports into
trustworthy battery awareness, charging qualification, and audience-specific notices
without assuming physical battery or flight behavior.

PURPOSE-01: The system will qualify battery evidence, remember whether that evidence has
recovered enough to be trusted, decide whether charging is currently eligible, control a
logical charge-authorization outcome, retain attention until explicit acknowledgement is
valid, and publish a battery-only readiness advisory. It shall not command or own drone
lifecycle transitions.

### Goals

GOAL-01: The system shall prevent logical charge authorization unless current battery,
charger, charging-interface, and contextual evidence jointly satisfy the selected
charge-eligibility policy.

GOAL-02: The system shall make invalid battery evidence immediately untrusted and shall
require two consecutive valid reports before battery evidence becomes trusted again.

GOAL-03: The system shall propagate distinct evidence and session conflicts to an exact
public fault vector and conservative notices without conflating a disconnected charger
with a charger fault.

GOAL-04: The system shall retain charge suspension and battery attention across evidence
recovery until the applicable fresh request is present in the current snapshot.

GOAL-05: The system shall publish mutually consistent authorization, request result,
notice, advisory, session, and fault outcomes from one winning composition of
owner-local facts.

### Operational context and exact system boundary

CTX-01: The Pilot/Status Consumer is the seed-mentioned human abstraction. It supplies
one current service request and receives notices and supervisory status; this does not
assert a physical control station or command protocol.

CTX-02: The Battery Management Source supplies qualitative capacity and report validity.
It remains responsible for the report; the supervisor does not model measurement
physics.

CTX-03: The Charger Context supplies a finite availability report and receives logical
authorization. `Permitted` is permission, not evidence that energy is flowing.

CTX-04: The Charging Interface Context supplies a finite report about the preceding
observation interval. `Active` means only that activity was reported, not that
electrical charging is proved.

CTX-05: The External Lifecycle Context Owner supplies the current named drone phase and
its validity. It alone owns that phase; no output from this system can change it.

CTX-06: The Flight-Control Notice Recipient receives battery attention only. It supplies
no input and this abstract assigns it no flight-control behavior.

MON-01: `serviceRequest`, from CTX-01, is exactly one of `None`, `Assess`,
`BeginCharge`, `EndCharge`, or `AcknowledgeNotice`. A request has effect only in the
snapshot in which that value is present.

MON-02: `batteryReport`, from CTX-02, is the product of band `Full`, `Nominal`, `Low`,
or `Critical` and status `Valid` or `Invalid`. Units and physical thresholds are
intentionally unspecified because the seed grounds only a qualitative indication.

MON-03: `chargerReport`, from CTX-03, is exactly `Disconnected`, `Ready`, `Faulted`, or
`Unknown`. `Disconnected` blocks charging but is not itself a fault; `Faulted` and
`Unknown` assert the charger-evidence fault.

MON-04: `chargeInterfaceReport`, from CTX-04, is exactly `Idle`, `Active`, `Faulted`, or
`Unknown`. `Faulted` and `Unknown` assert an interface-evidence fault; `Active` is
compared with the prior charge-session authorization.

MON-05: `lifecycleReport`, from CTX-05, is the product of phase `Off`, `Standby`,
`Charging`, `Ready`, or `Flying` and status `Valid` or `Invalid`. Charging context is
allowed only for valid `Off`, `Standby`, or `Charging`; this policy reads but never
transitions the phase.

CTRL-01: `chargeAuthorization`, to CTX-03, is exactly `Denied` or `Permitted`. It shall
be `Permitted` exactly when the new charge-session state is `Authorized` and the current
aggregate fault is false.

CTRL-02: `pilotNotice`, to CTX-01, is exactly `EvidenceUntrusted`, `Critical`, `Low`,
`ChargeAttention`, `RecoveryPending`, or `Clear`, selected by the notification priority
in `POL-NOTICE-01`.

CTRL-03: `flightControlNotice`, to CTX-06, is exactly `EvidenceUntrusted`, `Critical`,
`Low`, `RecoveryPending`, or `Clear`. Charger, interface, context, and session faults
alone do not create a flight-control battery notice.

CTRL-04: `pilotStatus`, to CTX-01, is the finite product of battery advisory
`Unknown/BatteryReady/ChargeQualified/ChargeBlocked/AirborneAttention`, charge session
`Idle/Eligible/Authorized/Suspended`, request result
`None/Accepted/Rejected/Deferred/NoEffect`, the five-bit fault vector, and aggregate
fault.

### Essential assumptions and constraints

ASM-01: CTX-01 is responsible for providing exactly one `MON-01` value per logical
snapshot. The single enum makes concurrent pilot requests impossible; this is a
deterministic pilot abstraction, not a claim about a real operator.

ASM-02: CTX-02 is responsible for pairing every qualitative band with explicit validity.
On `Invalid`, the band is present for type completeness but shall have no behavioral
authority.

ASM-03: CTX-03 is responsible for the four-valued `MON-03` report. The selected policy
treats `Ready` as usable, `Disconnected` as unavailable without fault, and
`Faulted/Unknown` as unavailable with fault.

ASM-04: CTX-04 is responsible for the four-valued `MON-04` report about the preceding
observation interval. Comparing `Active` with the prior session state avoids assuming
instantaneous physical response to the current output.

ASM-05: CTX-05 is responsible for a phase/status pair. Valid `Ready` and `Flying` block
charging but are not lifecycle faults; only invalid status asserts the context-evidence
fault.

ASM-06: The selected charge-need abstraction is `Full -> NotNeeded` and
`Nominal/Low/Critical -> needed` once battery evidence is trusted. This is a finite
policy choice without physical threshold or safety significance.

ASM-07: Two consecutive valid battery reports restore trust regardless of whether their
qualitative bands match. The purpose is to exercise bounded recovery ownership, not to
claim sensor-validation adequacy.

ASM-08: Every contract evaluation uses one atomic logical snapshot and the three owners'
prior states. No real period, latency, concurrency, or scheduling claim follows from
this assumption.

ASM-09: The logical initial states are battery confidence `Untrusted`, attention
`Attention`, and charge session `Idle`; all public authorization is safely `Denied`
before the first complete evaluation.

### Fault propagation, risks, and recovery

RISK-01: Invalid battery evidence accepted as trustworthy could permit charging or clear
attention from an ungrounded band; mitigation is immediate confidence loss, blocking,
notices, and two-valid-snapshot recovery.

RISK-02: Reported interface activity without prior authorization could remain unreported
or be mistaken for authorized operation; mitigation is highest- priority session
conflict, suspension, fault propagation, and denial.

RISK-03: Clearing local evidence faults could silently restore a prior charge
authorization or clear attention; mitigation is independent state retention and
fresh-request recovery.

## Supporting contract definitions

### State `Drone_Battery_Charge_Qualification_Supervisor::AttentionLatchStateOwner::attentionState`

State `attentionState` has type `Drone_Battery_Charge_Qualification_Supervisor::AttentionState`.

### State `Drone_Battery_Charge_Qualification_Supervisor::BatteryConfidenceStateOwner::confidenceState`

State `confidenceState` has type `Drone_Battery_Charge_Qualification_Supervisor::BatteryConfidence`.

### State `Drone_Battery_Charge_Qualification_Supervisor::ChargeSessionPriorityStateOwner::sessionState`

State `sessionState` has type `Drone_Battery_Charge_Qualification_Supervisor::SourceChargeSession`.

## Detailed behavioral requirements

### Requirements for AttentionLatchStateOwner

#### Contract clauses evaluated in the initialization phase

May modify: attentionState

##### `INITIAL_ATTENTION` — Required behavior

> During contract evaluation for the initialization phase, AttentionLatchStateOwner shall produce a result for which attentionState is Attention, resolutionToNotification newAttention is Attention, resolutionToNotification cause is Untrusted, resolutionToNotification attentionClearedNow is false, resolutionToNotification winningCase is ATTN 01, and clearedToRequestResult is false.

#### Contract clauses evaluated in the compute phase

May modify: attentionState

##### `ATTENTION_PUBLICATION` — Required behavior

> During contract evaluation for the compute phase, AttentionLatchStateOwner shall set resolutionToNotification newAttention to attentionState and clearedToRequestResult to true exactly when resolutionToNotification attentionClearedNow is true.

##### `ATTN_01_UNTRUSTED` — Conditional behavior

> During contract evaluation for the compute phase, if batteryIn confidence is not Trusted, AttentionLatchStateOwner shall produce a result for which attentionState is Attention, resolutionToNotification cause is Untrusted, resolutionToNotification attentionClearedNow is false, and resolutionToNotification winningCase is ATTN 01.

##### `ATTN_02_CRITICAL` — Conditional behavior

> During contract evaluation for the compute phase, if batteryIn confidence is Trusted and batteryIn band is Critical, AttentionLatchStateOwner shall produce a result for which attentionState is Attention, resolutionToNotification cause is Critical, resolutionToNotification attentionClearedNow is false, and resolutionToNotification winningCase is ATTN 02.

##### `ATTN_03_LOW` — Conditional behavior

> During contract evaluation for the compute phase, if batteryIn confidence is Trusted and batteryIn band is Low, AttentionLatchStateOwner shall produce a result for which attentionState is Attention, resolutionToNotification cause is Low, resolutionToNotification attentionClearedNow is false, and resolutionToNotification winningCase is ATTN 03.

##### `ATTN_04_FRESH_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT` — Conditional behavior

> During contract evaluation for the compute phase, if batteryIn confidence is Trusted, batteryIn band is not Critical, batteryIn band is not Low, the value of attentionState on entry is Attention, and requestIn is AcknowledgeNotice, AttentionLatchStateOwner shall produce a result for which attentionState is Clear, resolutionToNotification cause is Clear, resolutionToNotification attentionClearedNow is true, and resolutionToNotification winningCase is ATTN 04.

##### `ATTN_05_RECOVERY_PENDING` — Conditional behavior

> During contract evaluation for the compute phase, if batteryIn confidence is Trusted, batteryIn band is not Critical, batteryIn band is not Low, the value of attentionState on entry is Attention, and requestIn is not AcknowledgeNotice, AttentionLatchStateOwner shall produce a result for which attentionState is Attention, resolutionToNotification cause is RecoveryPending, resolutionToNotification attentionClearedNow is false, and resolutionToNotification winningCase is ATTN 05.

##### `ATTN_06_RETAIN_CLEAR` — Conditional behavior

> During contract evaluation for the compute phase, if batteryIn confidence is Trusted, batteryIn band is not Critical, batteryIn band is not Low, and the value of attentionState on entry is Clear, AttentionLatchStateOwner shall produce a result for which attentionState is Clear, resolutionToNotification cause is Clear, resolutionToNotification attentionClearedNow is false, and resolutionToNotification winningCase is ATTN 06.

### Requirements for AuthorizationStatusCompositionOwner

#### Contract clauses evaluated in the initialization phase

##### `INITIAL_PUBLIC_OUTCOMES` — Required behavior

> During contract evaluation for the initialization phase, AuthorizationStatusCompositionOwner shall produce a result for which chargeAuthorizationOut is Denied, pilotStatusOut statusAdvisory advisoryValue is ADVISORY UNKNOWN, pilotStatusOut statusSession sessionValue is Idle, pilotStatusOut statusRequestResult requestResultValue is None, pilotStatusOut faults batteryFault is true, pilotStatusOut faults chargerFault is true, pilotStatusOut faults interfaceFault is true, pilotStatusOut faults contextFault is true, pilotStatusOut faults sessionConflict is false, and pilotStatusOut aggregateFault is true.

#### Contract clauses evaluated in the compute phase

##### `STATUS_PRESERVES_OWNER_FACTS` — Required behavior

> During contract evaluation for the compute phase, AuthorizationStatusCompositionOwner shall set pilotStatusOut statusAdvisory advisoryValue to publicFactsIn advisory advisoryValue, pilotStatusOut statusSession sessionValue to publicFactsIn newSession sessionValue, pilotStatusOut statusRequestResult requestResultValue to publicFactsIn requestResult requestResultValue, pilotStatusOut faults batteryFault to true exactly when faultsIn vector batteryFault is true, pilotStatusOut faults chargerFault to true exactly when faultsIn vector chargerFault is true, pilotStatusOut faults interfaceFault to true exactly when faultsIn vector interfaceFault is true, pilotStatusOut faults contextFault to true exactly when faultsIn vector contextFault is true, pilotStatusOut faults sessionConflict to true exactly when faultsIn vector sessionConflict is true, and pilotStatusOut aggregateFault to true exactly when faultsIn aggregateFault is true.

##### `AUTHORIZATION_PERMITTED` — Conditional behavior

> During contract evaluation for the compute phase, if publicFactsIn newSession sessionValue is Authorized and faultsIn aggregateFault is false, AuthorizationStatusCompositionOwner shall set chargeAuthorizationOut to Permitted.

##### `AUTHORIZATION_DENIED` — Conditional behavior

> During contract evaluation for the compute phase, if publicFactsIn newSession sessionValue is not Authorized or faultsIn aggregateFault is true, AuthorizationStatusCompositionOwner shall set chargeAuthorizationOut to Denied.

### Requirements for BatteryAdvisoryDecisionOwner

#### Contract clauses evaluated in the initialization phase

##### `INITIAL_ADVISORY` — Required behavior

> During contract evaluation for the initialization phase, BatteryAdvisoryDecisionOwner shall set advisoryToRequestResult advisoryValue to ADVISORY UNKNOWN.

#### Contract clauses evaluated in the compute phase

##### `ADVISORY_UNKNOWN` — Conditional behavior

> During contract evaluation for the compute phase, if batteryIn confidence is not Trusted or lifecycleIn contextValid is false, BatteryAdvisoryDecisionOwner shall set advisoryToRequestResult advisoryValue to ADVISORY UNKNOWN.

##### `ADVISORY_AIRBORNE_ATTENTION` — Conditional behavior

> During contract evaluation for the compute phase, case ADVISORY AIRBORNE ATTENTION applies under all of the following conditions:
>
> All of the following conditions hold:
>
>   - batteryIn confidence is Trusted
>   - lifecycleIn contextValid is true
>   - lifecycleIn airborneContext is true
>   - At least one of the following conditions holds:
>     
>       - batteryIn band is Low
>       - batteryIn band is Critical.

Title: Isolette English → GUMBO Contract Synthesis Plan (for SysML v2 models)
Authoring context: Use Appendix A of FAA REMH (pp. 92–A25/A26) as the normative English source; SysML v2 structural models are provided; this plan tells the agent how to produce GUMBO contracts and embed them in the SysML v2 files for Sireum/HAMR/Logika verification.

---
0) OBJECTIVE
------------
Given: SysML v2 element structure (threads/parts/ports) exists but lacks GUMBO contracts.
Goal: Convert English requirements from Appendix A into GUMBO contracts embedded in each SysML v2 element, using the exact “language "GUMBO"” pattern found in the repo, suitable for Sireum CLI parse + HAMR codegen + Logika proof.

Primary English sources and anchors (Appendix A):
- A.1–A.2: Overview and use/exception cases (pp. 92 onward).
- A.3: External entities & environmental assumptions (EA-*).
- A.4: Safety requirements (e.g., alarm <= 5 s).
- A.5.*: Functions (Regulate/Monitor + subfunctions): includes concrete “shall” statements.
  • A.5.1.1 Manage Regulator Interface (MRI): REQ-MRI-* (display rounding, interface failure, desired range mux).
  • A.5.1.2 Manage Regulator Mode (MRM): diagram A-4 (INIT/NORMAL/FAILED + 1.0 s timeout).
  • A.5.1.3 Manage Heat Source (MHS): REQ-MHS-1..5 + latency rationale (<= 6 s).
  • A.5.2.1 Manage Monitor Interface (MMI): REQ-MMI-1..7 (monitor status, interface failure, alarm range mux).
  • A.5.2.2 Manage Monitor Mode (MMM): diagram A-6 (INIT/NORMAL/FAILED + 1.0 s timeout).
  • A.5.2.3 Manage Alarm (MA): REQ-MA-1..5 + hysteresis bands and <= 5 s activation.

---
1) CONTRACT EMBEDDING: CANONICAL BLOCK
--------------------------------------
Embed one GUMBO block per SysML v2 element that implements the English functionality (MRI, MRM, MHS, MMI, MMM, MA, etc.). Use the exact structure and section order shown below.

SysML v2 snippet (inside the element body):

language "GUMBO" /*{
  state
    // (optional) persistent variables for previous outputs, timers, accumulators
    lastCmd: Isolette_Data_Model::On_Off;

  functions
    // (optional) pure helper definitions; must be side-effect-free
    def timeout_condition_satisfied(): Base_Types::Boolean := T;

  integration
    // Environmental assumptions (EA-* tables), port/data range constraints, cross-component invariants
    assume <IdOrTableLabel> "Short text | <deep-pdf-link#page=N>":
      <boolean_formula>;
    // …more assumes…

  initialize
    // Guarantees at initialize entrypoint (one-cycle init behavior)
    guarantee <name>: <boolean_formula>;

  compute
    // Per-dispatch (periodic) behavioral logic; one case per English “shall”
    compute_cases
      case <CaseId> "English paraphrase | <deep-pdf-link#page=N>":
        assume <guards>;
        guarantee <post-conditions>;
      // more case …
}*/

Formatting constraints:
- Keep the quoted English + the deep PDF link in each case/assume (for traceability).
- Use model namespaces (e.g., Isolette_Data_Model::Status.Init_Status) exactly as in the SysML files.
- Use Wstatus records consistently (e.g., lower_alarm_tempWstatus.degrees, .status).
- Keep boolean syntax: & (and), | (or), implies, == equality, and literal T/F or true false if they are T/F are not defined (as used in your repo).

---
2) WHEN TO USE EACH SECTION
---------------------------
2.1 state
- Add if the English requires memory:
  • Hysteresis “shall not be changed” / “hold previous” (Heat within desired band; Alarm no-change band).
  • Timeouts (duration in mode > 1.0 s) if not directly available from the platform as a primitive.
  Pattern examples:
    lastHeat: Isolette_Data_Model::On_Off
    initElapsed: Base_Types::S64  // time units per your modeling conventions

2.2 functions
- Add pure helper predicates for reusable logic, e.g.:
    def in_reset_band(t, lo, hi): Boolean := lo + 0.5[s32] <= t & t <= hi - 0.5[s32]

2.3 integration 
Guarantees: When to Use
-----------------------------------
Use **integration.guarantee** when your element is the **producer** of a property that:
- Must hold for **all time** (init + compute).
- Is **not** contingent on a transient case condition (e.g., mode or alarm band), and
- Is best treated as a cross-interface invariant (e.g., ordering, units, encoding domain).

- Place environmental assumptions (EA-*). Typical content:
  • Sensor temperature range/units/precision (A.3.2).
  • Isolette warm/cool slew limits ±1°F/min (A.3.1) – used to justify latency.
  • Operator Interface ranges and ordering of desired/alarm temps (A.3.4).
  Example:
    assume Table_A_12_LowerAlarmTemp "...|#page=112": 96 [s32] <= lower_alarm_tempWstatus.degrees & lower_alarm_tempWstatus.degrees <= 101 [s32];
    assume Table_A_12_UpperAlarmTemp "...|#page=112": 97 [s32] <= upper_alarm_tempWstatus.degrees & upper_alarm_tempWstatus.degrees <= 102 [s32];


2.4 initialize
- Add when English clearly states init entry behavior (e.g., status initially Init).
  Example (MMI REQ-MMI-1): monitor_status == Isolette_Data_Model::Status.Init_Status.

2.5 compute / compute_cases
compute 
- You may add assume/guarantees if they the English suggests they hold for all of the below compute_cases.
Compute_cases
- Create one case per “shall”. Each case:
  • “assume” = guard from the English (mode, value status, inequality).
  • “guarantee” = post-condition effect on outputs/state.
- Use English paraphrase + deep link in case title.

  See below as an example:
  ---------------------------
/* Manage_Monitor_Interface_Contracts */ 
 
  compute
     may add assume/guarantees if the the English suggests they hold for all of the below compute_cases.
    compute_cases
      case REQ_MMI_1 "If mode INIT ⇒ status Init |<pdf#page=113>":
        assume monitor_mode == Isolette_Data_Model::Monitor_Mode.Init_Monitor_Mode;
        guarantee monitor_status == Isolette_Data_Model::Status.Init_Status;

      case REQ_MMI_2 "If mode NORMAL ⇒ status On |<pdf#page=113>":
        assume monitor_mode == Isolette_Data_Model::Monitor_Mode.Normal_Monitor_Mode;
        guarantee monitor_status == Isolette_Data_Model::Status.On_Status;

      case REQ_MMI_3 "If mode FAILED ⇒ status Failed |<pdf#page=113>":
        assume monitor_mode == Isolette_Data_Model::Monitor_Mode.Failed_Monitor_Mode;
        guarantee monitor_status == Isolette_Data_Model::Status.Failed_Status;

      case REQ_MMI_4 "If lower OR upper status Invalid ⇒ interface failure True |<pdf#page=113>":
        assume lower_alarm_tempWstatus.status == Isolette_Data_Model::ValueStatus.Invalid |
               upper_alarm_tempWstatus.status == Isolette_Data_Model::ValueStatus.Invalid;
        guarantee interface_failure.flag;

      case REQ_MMI_5 "If lower AND upper status Valid ⇒ interface failure False |<pdf#page=113>":
        assume lower_alarm_tempWstatus.status == Isolette_Data_Model::ValueStatus.Valid &
               upper_alarm_tempWstatus.status == Isolette_Data_Model::ValueStatus.Valid;
        guarantee not interface_failure.flag;

      case REQ_MMI_6 "If NOT interface failure ⇒ copy alarm range (mux) |<pdf#page=113>":
        assume T;
        guarantee (not interface_failure.flag) implies
          (lower_alarm_temp.degrees == lower_alarm_tempWstatus.degrees &
           upper_alarm_temp.degrees == upper_alarm_tempWstatus.degrees);

      case REQ_MMI_7 "If interface failure True ⇒ UNSPECIFIED |<pdf#page=113>":
        assume T;
        guarantee interface_failure.flag implies true;
}*/

3) LEARNED META-RULES
---------------------
Only rules accepted by this experiment may appear between the markers.

---------------

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Acceptance gate 2: prove both application entrypoints in every HAMR component.
set -euo pipefail

if [[ $# -lt 1 || $# -gt 2 ]]; then
  echo "usage: $0 <hamr-slang-root> [proof-output-directory]" >&2
  exit 2
fi

slang=$(realpath "$1")
proof_arg=${2:-$slang/proof}
mkdir -p "$proof_arg"
proof=$(realpath "$proof_arg")
work=$(realpath "$slang/../..")
component_root="$slang/src/main/component"
manifest="$work/generated-nonapplication.sha256"
allowlist="$work/generated-component-files.txt"
work_manifest="$work/protected-work-files.sha256"

[[ -d $component_root ]] || { echo "component root not found: $component_root" >&2; exit 2; }
[[ -f $manifest && -f $allowlist && -f $work_manifest ]] || {
  echo "prepared phase manifests are missing" >&2; exit 2;
}

if [[ -n ${SIREUM_BIN:-} ]]; then
  sireum=$(realpath "$SIREUM_BIN")
elif [[ -n ${SIREUM_HOME:-} ]]; then
  sireum=$(realpath "$SIREUM_HOME/bin/sireum")
else
  sireum=$(command -v sireum || true)
fi
[[ -n $sireum && -x $sireum ]] || {
  echo "Sireum executable not found; set SIREUM_BIN or SIREUM_HOME" >&2
  exit 2
}

# Fail closed if the application phase changed any generated non-application
# file or added/deleted a component application file.
if ! (cd "$slang" && sha256sum --check --quiet "$manifest"); then
  echo "generated non-application files changed after codegen" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if ! (cd "$work" && sha256sum --check --quiet "$work_manifest"); then
  echo "protected application-phase inputs changed after preparation" >&2
  exit 1
fi
current=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$current"' EXIT
(
  cd "$slang"
  find src/main/component -type f -name '*.scala' -print | sort
) >"$current"
if ! cmp -s "$allowlist" "$current"; then
  echo "component application file set differs from the generated allowlist" >&2
  diff -u "$allowlist" "$current" >&2 || true
  exit 1
fi

mapfile -t relative_components <"$allowlist"
[[ ${#relative_components[@]} -gt 0 ]] || { echo "no generated components found" >&2; exit 1; }

method_timeout=${LOGIKA_METHOD_TIMEOUT:-30}
process_timeout=${LOGIKA_PROCESS_TIMEOUT:-180}
rlimit=${LOGIKA_RLIMIT:-2000000}
index=0
failures=0

for relative in "${relative_components[@]}"; do
  component="$slang/$relative"
  for method in initialise timeTriggered; do
    mapfile -t lines < <(
      awk -v method="$method" '
        $0 ~ ("^[[:space:]]*def[[:space:]]+" method "[[:space:]]*\\(") { print NR }
      ' "$component"
    )
    if [[ ${#lines[@]} -ne 1 ]]; then
      echo "$relative must contain exactly one $method method; found ${#lines[@]}" >&2
      failures=$((failures + 1))
      continue
    fi
    safe_name=$(printf '%s-%s' "${relative%.scala}" "$method" | tr '/ ' '__')
    log=$(printf '%s/%03d-%s.log' "$proof" "$index" "$safe_name")
    index=$((index + 1))
    command=(
      "$sireum" proyek logika
      --timeout "$method_timeout"
      --rlimit "$rlimit"
      --par
      --line "${lines[0]}"
      "$slang"
      "$component"
    )
    printf 'PROVING %s:%s line=%s\n' "$relative" "$method" "${lines[0]}"
    set +e
    timeout "$process_timeout" "${command[@]}" >"$log" 2>&1
    rc=$?
    set -e
    cat "$log"
    if [[ $rc -ne 0 ]] || \
       grep -Eqi 'Resolution error:|Compilation failed|RUN ABORTED|(^|[[:space:]])error:|\*\*\* Failed \*\*\*' "$log"; then
      echo "LOGIKA_FAILED component=$relative method=$method rc=$rc" >&2
      failures=$((failures + 1))
    else
      echo "LOGIKA_PASSED component=$relative method=$method"
    fi
  done
done

if [[ $failures -ne 0 ]]; then
  echo "APPLICATION_LOGIKA_FAILED failures=$failures methods_attempted=$index" >&2
  exit 1
fi
printf 'APPLICATION_LOGIKA_PASSED components=%s methods=%s\n' \
  "${#relative_components[@]}" "$index"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create a codegen-only periodic projection of one candidate SysML model.

This helper deliberately accepts one explicit model path.  It never searches a
dataset tree and rejects evaluator/oracle paths, so staging cannot expose an
answer model to an application agent.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
from pathlib import Path


THREAD = re.compile(
    r"(?m)^(?P<indent>[ \t]*)part\s+def\s+[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\s+:>\s+(?:AADL::)?Thread\s*\{[ \t]*$"
)
GUMBO_BLOCK = re.compile(
    r'(?P<open>language\s+"GUMBO"\s*/\*\{)(?P<body>.*?)(?P<close>\}\*/)',
    re.DOTALL,
)
GUMBO_INITIALIZE = re.compile(
    r"(?ms)^(?P<indent>[ \t]*)initialize[ \t]*(?:\r?\n)"
    r".*?(?=^(?P=indent)(?:compute|functions|invariants|integration|state)\b|\Z)"
)
PACKAGE = re.compile(r"(?m)^\s*package\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*\{")
SYSTEM_DEF = re.compile(
    r"(?m)^\s*part\s+def\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s+:>\s+(?:AADL::)?System\s*\{"
)
PART_USE = re.compile(
    r"(?m)^(?P<indent>[ \t]*)part\s+[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\s*:\s*"
    r"(?P<target>[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*;"
)


def sha256(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def portable_path(path: Path) -> str:
    return Path(os.path.relpath(path.resolve(), Path.cwd().resolve())).as_posix()


def reject_contaminating_path(path: Path) -> None:
    lowered = {part.lower() for part in path.parts}
    if "evaluator" in lowered or path.name.lower() == "oracle.sysml":
        raise SystemExit("refusing evaluator/oracle model path")


def _blank_preserving_lines(value: str) -> str:
    """Erase source text while retaining exact line and column positions."""
    return "".join(character if character in "\r\n" else " " for character in value)


def strip_gumbo_initialization_sections(text: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
    """Remove initialization contracts from the non-normative codegen view.

    HAMR initialization APIs do not expose input ports.  Consequently, an
    otherwise valid model-level ``initialize`` guarantee that refers to an
    input generates uncompilable Slang (both Initialization_Api and PostState
    containers lack that member).  Selectively rewriting expressions would
    invent semantics, so the executable projection consistently removes the
    complete initialization section from every GUMBO block.  The original
    candidate is checked by model Logika before this projection is created.

    Whitespace replacement preserves line numbers for diagnostics and leaves
    state, functions, invariants, integration, and compute sections verbatim.
    """
    removed = 0

    def project_block(block_match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
        nonlocal removed
        body = block_match.group("body")

        def remove_section(section_match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
            nonlocal removed
            removed += 1
            return _blank_preserving_lines(section_match.group(0))

        projected_body = GUMBO_INITIALIZE.sub(remove_section, body)
        return block_match.group("open") + projected_body + block_match.group("close")

    return GUMBO_BLOCK.sub(project_block, text), removed


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("source", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("destination", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("metadata", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--period-ms", type=int, default=1000)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    source = args.source.resolve()
    destination = args.destination.resolve()
    metadata = args.metadata.resolve()
    reject_contaminating_path(source)
    if args.period_ms <= 0:
        raise SystemExit("--period-ms must be positive")

    original = source.read_bytes()
    text = original.decode("utf-8")
    packages = PACKAGE.findall(text)
    if len(packages) != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f"expected exactly one package, found {packages}")
    system_defs = set(SYSTEM_DEF.findall(text))
    system_uses = [
        (len(match.group("indent").expandtabs()), match.group("target"))
        for match in PART_USE.finditer(text)
        if match.group("target") in system_defs
    ]
    shallowest = min((depth for depth, _ in system_uses), default=-1)
    roots = [target for depth, target in system_uses if depth == shallowest]
    if len(roots) != 1:
        raise SystemExit(
            "expected exactly one root part usage targeting a System definition, "
            f"found {roots}"
        )
    if re.search(r"\bDispatch_Protocol\b|attribute\s+:>>\s+Period\b", text):
        raise SystemExit(
            "candidate already contains dispatch/period refinements; refusing to "
            "guess how to normalize them"
        )

    count = 0

    def add_periodic(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
        nonlocal count
        count += 1
        indent = match.group("indent") + "  "
        return (
            match.group(0)
            + "\n"
            + indent
            + "attribute :>> Dispatch_Protocol = Periodic;\n"
            + indent
            + f"attribute :>> Period = {args.period_ms} [ms];"
        )

    projected = THREAD.sub(add_periodic, text)
    if count == 0:
        raise SystemExit("candidate contains no Thread definitions")
    if projected.count("attribute :>> Dispatch_Protocol = Periodic;") != count:
        raise SystemExit("internal projection error: dispatch count does not match Threads")
    if projected.count(f"attribute :>> Period = {args.period_ms} [ms];") != count:
        raise SystemExit("internal projection error: period count does not match Threads")
    periodic_projection = projected
    projected, initialization_sections_removed = strip_gumbo_initialization_sections(
        periodic_projection
    )
    if projected.count("\n") != periodic_projection.count("\n"):
        raise SystemExit("internal projection error: initialization removal changed line count")
    remaining_initialization_headers = sum(
        len(re.findall(r"(?m)^[ \t]*initialize[ \t]*$", match.group("body")))
        for match in GUMBO_BLOCK.finditer(projected)
    )
    if remaining_initialization_headers:
        raise SystemExit(
            "unsupported GUMBO initialization layout remained after codegen projection"
        )

    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    metadata.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination.write_text(projected, encoding="utf-8")
    result = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "source": portable_path(source),
        "source_sha256": sha256(original),
        "projection": portable_path(destination),
        "projection_sha256": sha256(projected.encode("utf-8")),
        "package": packages[0],
        "system_definition": roots[0],
        "system_name": f"{packages[0]}::{roots[0]}",
        "thread_count": count,
        "period_ms": args.period_ms,
        "initialization_projection": "removed_from_codegen_view",
        "initialization_sections_removed": initialization_sections_removed,
    }
    metadata.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(result))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Gate the original model, then create an isolated executable/codegen projection.
set -euo pipefail

usage() {
  echo "usage: $0 <agent/M-star.sysml> <new-work-directory> [external/sysml-aadl-libraries]" >&2
  exit 2
}

[[ $# -ge 2 && $# -le 3 ]] || usage

script_dir=$(realpath "$(dirname "$0")")
repo_root=$(realpath "$script_dir/..")
model=$(realpath "$1")
work_arg=$2
library=$(realpath "${3:-$repo_root/external/sysml-aadl-libraries}")

lower_model=${model,,}
case "/$lower_model/" in
  */evaluator/*|*/oracle.sysml/) echo "refusing evaluator/oracle model path" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
[[ -f $model && $model == *.sysml ]] || { echo "candidate model not found: $model" >&2; exit 2; }
[[ -d $library ]] || { echo "SysML AADL library not found: $library" >&2; exit 2; }
requirements="$(dirname "$model")/N.md"
[[ -f $requirements ]] || { echo "candidate requirements not found beside model: $requirements" >&2; exit 2; }

if [[ -e $work_arg ]]; then
  work=$(realpath "$work_arg")
  if find "$work" -mindepth 1 -print -quit | grep -q .; then
    echo "work directory must be new or empty: $work" >&2
    exit 2
  fi
else
  mkdir -p "$work_arg"
  work=$(realpath "$work_arg")
fi

if [[ -n ${SIREUM_BIN:-} ]]; then
  sireum=$(realpath "$SIREUM_BIN")
elif [[ -n ${SIREUM_HOME:-} ]]; then
  sireum=$(realpath "$SIREUM_HOME/bin/sireum")
else
  sireum=$(command -v sireum || true)
fi
[[ -n $sireum && -x $sireum ]] || {
  echo "Sireum executable not found; set SIREUM_BIN or SIREUM_HOME" >&2
  exit 2
}

mkdir -p "$work/evidence" "$work/staged" "$work/hamr"
cp "$requirements" "$work/N.md"
if [[ -f "$(dirname "$model")/.poolside/settings.local.yaml" ]]; then
  mkdir -p "$work/.poolside"
  cp "$(dirname "$model")/.poolside/settings.local.yaml" "$work/.poolside/settings.local.yaml"
fi
source_hash_before=$(sha256sum "$model" | awk '{print $1}')

# Acceptance gate 1 is intentionally run against the original candidate, not
# the executable projection. Keep the invocation identical to the campaign's
# named `sireum hamr sysml logika` gate.
set +e
"$sireum" hamr sysml logika \
  --sourcepath "$library" \
  "$model" >"$work/evidence/original-model-logika.log" 2>&1
integration_rc=$?
set -e
cat "$work/evidence/original-model-logika.log"
if [[ $integration_rc -ne 0 ]] || \
   grep -Eqi 'Resolution error:|Compilation failed|(^|[[:space:]])error:' "$work/evidence/original-model-logika.log"; then
  echo "ORIGINAL_MODEL_LOGIKA_FAILED rc=$integration_rc" >&2
  exit 1
fi

projection="$work/staged/M-star.executable.sysml"
metadata="$work/staged/projection.json"
python3 "$script_dir/stage_executable_model.py" \
  "$model" "$projection" "$metadata" >"$work/evidence/projection.jsonl"

package=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["package"])' "$metadata")
system_name=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["system_name"])' "$metadata")
slang_package=$(printf '%s' "$package" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')

set +e
"$sireum" hamr sysml codegen \
  --platform JVM \
  --runtime-monitoring \
  --package-name "$slang_package" \
  --output-dir "$work/hamr" \
  --slang-output-dir "$work/hamr/slang" \
  --no-proyek-ive \
  --workspace-root-dir "$work/staged" \
  --sourcepath "$work/staged:$library" \
  --system-name "$system_name" \
  "$projection" >"$work/evidence/codegen.log" 2>&1
codegen_rc=$?
set -e
cat "$work/evidence/codegen.log"
if [[ $codegen_rc -ne 0 ]] || grep -Eqi 'Resolution error:|Compilation failed|(^|[[:space:]])error:' "$work/evidence/codegen.log"; then
  echo "EXECUTABLE_CODEGEN_FAILED rc=$codegen_rc" >&2
  exit 1
fi

slang="$work/hamr/slang"
component_root="$slang/src/main/component"
[[ -f $slang/bin/project.cmd ]] || { echo "codegen produced no Proyek project" >&2; exit 1; }
mapfile -d '' components < <(find "$component_root" -type f -name '*.scala' -print0 | sort -z)
[[ ${#components[@]} -gt 0 ]] || { echo "codegen produced no component applications" >&2; exit 1; }
for component in "${components[@]}"; do
  grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*def[[:space:]]+initialise[[:space:]]*\(' "$component" || {
    echo "generated component lacks initialise: $component" >&2; exit 1;
  }
  grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*def[[:space:]]+timeTriggered[[:space:]]*\(' "$component" || {
    echo "generated component lacks timeTriggered: $component" >&2; exit 1;
  }
done

source_hash_after=$(sha256sum "$model" | awk '{print $1}')
[[ $source_hash_before == "$source_hash_after" ]] || {
  echo "original candidate changed during projection/codegen" >&2; exit 1;
}

# Freeze the generated surface outside HAMR's application files.  The later
# proof gate verifies both this hash manifest and the component-file allowlist.
(
  cd "$slang"
  find . -type f \
    ! -path './src/main/component/*' \
    ! -path './out/*' \
    -print0 \
    | sort -z \
    | xargs -0 sha256sum
) >"$work/generated-nonapplication.sha256"
(
  cd "$slang"
  find src/main/component -type f -name '*.scala' -print | sort
) >"$work/generated-component-files.txt"
cp "$script_dir/run-logika.sh" "$work/run-logika.sh"
chmod u+x "$work/run-logika.sh"

cat >"$work/APPLICATION_PHASE.txt" <<EOF
POOLside application phase boundary

Writable application files:
  $component_root/**/*.scala

Read-only requirements:
  $work/N.md

Do not edit the staged SysML, generated bridge/API/data/runtime/project files,
the manifests, or this gate.  After the application agent implements every
generated initialise and timeTriggered body, run the command below.  HAMR
Initialization_Api values expose output setters but no input getters: initialise
must establish safe state/outputs without reading an input port.

  $work/run-logika.sh $slang $work/proof
EOF

# Protect the entire retained phase input, while excluding Logika's mutable
# cache/output tree and the application allowlist itself.
(
  cd "$work"
  find . -type f \
    ! -path './hamr/slang/src/main/component/*' \
    ! -path './hamr/slang/out/*' \
    ! -path './proof/*' \
    ! -path './protected-work-files.sha256' \
    -print0 \
    | sort -z \
    | xargs -0 sha256sum
) >"$work/protected-work-files.sha256"
find "$work" -type f \
  ! -path "$component_root/*" \
  ! -path "$slang/out/*" \
  ! -path "$work/proof/*" \
  -exec chmod a-w {} +
find "$component_root" -type f -name '*.scala' -exec chmod u+w,go-w {} +

printf 'EXECUTABLE_PREPARED work=%s components=%s system=%s\n' \
  "$work" "${#components[@]}" "$system_name"
printf 'APPLICATION_ROOT=%s\n' "$component_root"
printf 'NEXT=%q\ %q\ %q\n' "$work/run-logika.sh" "$slang" "$work/proof"

## Supporting contract definitions

### State `Drone_Battery_Charge_Qualification_Supervisor::AttentionLatchStateOwner::attentionState`

State `attentionState` has type `Drone_Battery_Charge_Qualification_Supervisor::AttentionState`.

### State `Drone_Battery_Charge_Qualification_Supervisor::BatteryConfidenceStateOwner::confidenceState`

State `confidenceState` has type `Drone_Battery_Charge_Qualification_Supervisor::BatteryConfidence`.

### State `Drone_Battery_Charge_Qualification_Supervisor::ChargeSessionPriorityStateOwner::sessionState`

State `sessionState` has type `Drone_Battery_Charge_Qualification_Supervisor::SourceChargeSession`.

## Detailed behavioral requirements

### Requirements for AttentionLatchStateOwner

#### Contract clauses evaluated in the initialization phase

May modify: attentionState

##### `INITIAL_ATTENTION` — Required behavior

> During contract evaluation for the initialization phase, AttentionLatchStateOwner shall produce a result for which attentionState is Attention, resolutionToNotification newAttention is Attention, resolutionToNotification cause is Untrusted, resolutionToNotification attentionClearedNow is false, resolutionToNotification winningCase is ATTN 01, and clearedToRequestResult is false.

#### Contract clauses evaluated in the compute phase

May modify: attentionState

##### `ATTENTION_PUBLICATION` — Required behavior

> During contract evaluation for the compute phase, AttentionLatchStateOwner shall set resolutionToNotification newAttention to attentionState and clearedToRequestResult to true exactly when resolutionToNotification attentionClearedNow is true.

##### `ATTN_01_UNTRUSTED` — Conditional behavior

> During contract evaluation for the compute phase, if batteryIn confidence is not Trusted, AttentionLatchStateOwner shall produce a result for which attentionState is Attention, resolutionToNotification cause is Untrusted, resolutionToNotification attentionClearedNow is false, and resolutionToNotification winningCase is ATTN 01.

##### `ATTN_02_CRITICAL` — Conditional behavior

> During contract evaluation for the compute phase, if batteryIn confidence is Trusted and batteryIn band is Critical, AttentionLatchStateOwner shall produce a result for which attentionState is Attention, resolutionToNotification cause is Critical, resolutionToNotification attentionClearedNow is false, and resolutionToNotification winningCase is ATTN 02.

##### `ATTN_03_LOW` — Conditional behavior

> During contract evaluation for the compute phase, if batteryIn confidence is Trusted and batteryIn band is Low, AttentionLatchStateOwner shall produce a result for which attentionState is Attention, resolutionToNotification cause is Low, resolutionToNotification attentionClearedNow is false, and resolutionToNotification winningCase is ATTN 03.

##### `ATTN_04_FRESH_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT` — Conditional behavior

> During contract evaluation for the compute phase, if batteryIn confidence is Trusted, batteryIn band is not Critical, batteryIn band is not Low, the value of attentionState on entry is Attention, and requestIn is AcknowledgeNotice, AttentionLatchStateOwner shall produce a result for which attentionState is Clear, resolutionToNotification cause is Clear, resolutionToNotification attentionClearedNow is true, and resolutionToNotification winningCase is ATTN 04.

##### `ATTN_05_RECOVERY_PENDING` — Conditional behavior

> During contract evaluation for the compute phase, if batteryIn confidence is Trusted, batteryIn band is not Critical, batteryIn band is not Low, the value of attentionState on entry is Attention, and requestIn is not AcknowledgeNotice, AttentionLatchStateOwner shall produce a result for which attentionState is Attention, resolutionToNotification cause is RecoveryPending, resolutionToNotification attentionClearedNow is false, and resolutionToNotification winningCase is ATTN 05.

##### `ATTN_06_RETAIN_CLEAR` — Conditional behavior

> During contract evaluation for the compute phase, if batteryIn confidence is Trusted, batteryIn band is not Critical, batteryIn band is not Low, and the value of attentionState on entry is Clear, AttentionLatchStateOwner shall produce a result for which attentionState is Clear, resolutionToNotification cause is Clear, resolutionToNotification attentionClearedNow is false, and resolutionToNotification winningCase is ATTN 06.

### Requirements for AuthorizationStatusCompositionOwner

#### Contract clauses evaluated in the initialization phase

##### `INITIAL_PUBLIC_OUTCOMES` — Required behavior

> During contract evaluation for the initialization phase, AuthorizationStatusCompositionOwner shall produce a result for which chargeAuthorizationOut is Denied, pilotStatusOut statusAdvisory advisoryValue is ADVISORY UNKNOWN, pilotStatusOut statusSession sessionValue is Idle, pilotStatusOut statusRequestResult requestResultValue is None, pilotStatusOut faults batteryFault is true, pilotStatusOut faults chargerFault is true, pilotStatusOut faults interfaceFault is true, pilotStatusOut faults contextFault is true, pilotStatusOut faults sessionConflict is false, and pilotStatusOut aggregateFault is true.

#### Contract clauses evaluated in the compute phase

##### `STATUS_PRESERVES_OWNER_FACTS` — Required behavior

> During contract evaluation for the compute phase, AuthorizationStatusCompositionOwner shall set pilotStatusOut statusAdvisory advisoryValue to publicFactsIn advisory advisoryValue, pilotStatusOut statusSession sessionValue to publicFactsIn newSession sessionValue, pilotStatusOut statusRequestResult requestResultValue to publicFactsIn requestResult requestResultValue, pilotStatusOut faults batteryFault to true exactly when faultsIn vector batteryFault is true, pilotStatusOut faults chargerFault to true exactly when faultsIn vector chargerFault is true, pilotStatusOut faults interfaceFault to true exactly when faultsIn vector interfaceFault is true, pilotStatusOut faults contextFault to true exactly when faultsIn vector contextFault is true, pilotStatusOut faults sessionConflict to true exactly when faultsIn vector sessionConflict is true, and pilotStatusOut aggregateFault to true exactly when faultsIn aggregateFault is true.

##### `AUTHORIZATION_PERMITTED` — Conditional behavior

> During contract evaluation for the compute phase, if publicFactsIn newSession sessionValue is Authorized and faultsIn aggregateFault is false, AuthorizationStatusCompositionOwner shall set chargeAuthorizationOut to Permitted.

##### `AUTHORIZATION_DENIED` — Conditional behavior

> During contract evaluation for the compute phase, if publicFactsIn newSession sessionValue is not Authorized or faultsIn aggregateFault is true, AuthorizationStatusCompositionOwner shall set chargeAuthorizationOut to Denied.

### Requirements for BatteryAdvisoryDecisionOwner

#### Contract clauses evaluated in the initialization phase

##### `INITIAL_ADVISORY` — Required behavior

> During contract evaluation for the initialization phase, BatteryAdvisoryDecisionOwner shall set advisoryToRequestResult advisoryValue to ADVISORY UNKNOWN.

#### Contract clauses evaluated in the compute phase

##### `ADVISORY_UNKNOWN` — Conditional behavior

> During contract evaluation for the compute phase, if batteryIn confidence is not Trusted or lifecycleIn contextValid is false, BatteryAdvisoryDecisionOwner shall set advisoryToRequestResult advisoryValue to ADVISORY UNKNOWN.

##### `ADVISORY_AIRBORNE_ATTENTION` — Conditional behavior

> During contract evaluation for the compute phase, case ADVISORY AIRBORNE ATTENTION applies under all of the following conditions:
>
> All of the following conditions hold:
>
>   - batteryIn confidence is Trusted
>   - lifecycleIn contextValid is true
>   - lifecycleIn airborneContext is true
>   - At least one of the following conditions holds:
>     
>       - batteryIn band is Low
>       - batteryIn band is Critical.

> When all applicability conditions are met, BatteryAdvisoryDecisionOwner shall produce a result for which all of the following conditions hold:
>
> advisoryToRequestResult advisoryValue is AIRBORNE ATTENTION.

##### `ADVISORY_BATTERY_READY` — Conditional behavior

> During contract evaluation for the compute phase, case ADVISORY BATTERY READY applies under all of the following conditions:
>
> All of the following conditions hold:
>
>   - batteryIn confidence is Trusted
>   - lifecycleIn contextValid is true
>   - At least one of the following conditions holds:
>     
>       - batteryIn band is Full
>       - batteryIn band is Nominal.

> When all applicability conditions are met, BatteryAdvisoryDecisionOwner shall produce a result for which all of the following conditions hold:
>
> advisoryToRequestResult advisoryValue is BATTERY READY.

##### `ADVISORY_CHARGE_QUALIFIED` — Conditional behavior

> During contract evaluation for the compute phase, case ADVISORY CHARGE QUALIFIED applies under all of the following conditions:
>
> All of the following conditions hold:
>
>   - batteryIn confidence is Trusted
>   - lifecycleIn contextValid is true
>   - lifecycleIn airborneContext is false
>   - At least one of the following conditions holds:
>     
>       - batteryIn band is Low
>       - batteryIn band is Critical
>   - eligibilityIn is Permitted.

> When all applicability conditions are met, BatteryAdvisoryDecisionOwner shall produce a result for which all of the following conditions hold:
>
> advisoryToRequestResult advisoryValue is CHARGE QUALIFIED.

##### `ADVISORY_CHARGE_BLOCKED` — Conditional behavior

> During contract evaluation for the compute phase, case ADVISORY CHARGE BLOCKED applies under all of the following conditions:
>
> All of the following conditions hold:
>
>   - batteryIn confidence is Trusted
>   - lifecycleIn contextValid is true
>   - lifecycleIn airborneContext is false
>   - At least one of the following conditions holds:
>     
>       - batteryIn band is Low
>       - batteryIn band is Critical
>   - eligibilityIn is not Permitted.

> When all applicability conditions are met, BatteryAdvisoryDecisionOwner shall produce a result for which all of the following conditions hold:
>
> advisoryToRequestResult advisoryValue is CHARGE BLOCKED.

### Requirements for BatteryConfidenceStateOwner

#### Contract clauses evaluated in the initialization phase
